scope: Two new-to-tracked-history real public MIT source projects, unmodified selected HTML/CSS, paired with newly authored acceptance research tasks. Six criteria per project. Source-only benchmark, not original client requests or customer deployments. Parent knew repository names and task families before this sealing but has not read final questions/references before the current source/catalog work stabilized.
referenceMethod: AI author independently fixed two source-supported/two source-contradicted/two observation-required criteria per project from original source before any model assessment. Raw markup/labels/attributes and grouped business text are distinguished from runtime, visual, storage and authentication evidence. Root did not author or inspect the final labels before sealing. These are source-reviewed convenience tasks, not a blinded human gold-standard study.

criteria.title: Original requirement 1
criteria.source: The homepage lunch menu and full menu source content must each pair Cacio e pepe with the V tag and advertised price £14

reference.rationale: Both original HTML files have the Cacio e pepe dish-name span with V tag and the same adjacent £14 dish-price span in the same dish row. This establishes published source content and row association only, not the correctness of the food label or payment. No AUD or USD is inferred from the pound symbol.

criteria.title: Original requirement 2
criteria.source: The full menu page copy must include the literal phrase Updated daily

reference.rationale: menu.html has a simple text-only p containing Updated daily. The source phrase is present. It is an authored static-copy task; it does not establish that a daily update actually runs or that the real menu is current.

criteria.title: Original requirement 3
criteria.source: The homepage and full menu source content must both attach the GF tag to Whipped cod roe

reference.rationale: The homepage Whipped cod roe dish row contains a GF tag, whereas the full-menu Whipped cod roe row has no dietary tag. Other full-menu GF tags belong to other dish rows and cannot establish this item. The requirement checks source consistency, not actual allergen safety or rendered visibility.

criteria.title: Original requirement 4
criteria.source: The full menu source copy must pair Nero d’Avola in the By the glass section with advertised price £10

reference.rationale: The By the glass section in menu.html lists Nero d'Avola with £8 rather than required pound10. The typographic apostrophe variation in the task does not change the named wine; this is a numeric advertised-copy mismatch, not a comma-only title change. No currency conversion or AUD/USD lock is inferred.

criteria.title: Original requirement 5
criteria.source: The reservation flow must actually persist the booking and email a confirmation retrievable after a server restart

reference.rationale: A demo-marked booking form and confirmation copy do not prove backend persistence, delivery of email, or independent readback after restart. External JS/backend were not supplied or executed. The task must not be passed from text or declared an actual server failure solely from HTML.

criteria.title: Original requirement 6
criteria.source: At a 375px viewport the Lunch Dinner and Sunday tabs must switch correctly without horizontal overflow

reference.rationale: The supplied files have tab markup and custom CSS, but no browser interaction or geometry observation was made. The large Bootstrap CSS and JS are outside the source subset. File declarations cannot establish successful switching or measured overflow.

criteria.title: Original requirement 1
criteria.source: The static HTML labels Name Password and Email on sign-up.html must each target its matching input through a for and id pair

reference.rationale: The sign-up source has Name for=name with input id=name, Password for=password with input id=password, and Email for=e-mail with input id=e-mail. This is a static label/control association only. It neither requires nor implies usable live registration, safe secret handling, focus behavior or proper input types.

criteria.title: Original requirement 2
criteria.source: The forms.html source content must pair Fulltime Part time and Remote radio labels with values 1 2 and 3 under the same employment name

reference.rationale: The three source label wrappers for partition-fulltime, partition-partTime and partition-remote contain radio inputs with name=employment and values1/2/3 respectively, plus Fulltime/Part time/Remote label spans. These must be witnessed as matching grouped tuples, not unrelated strings elsewhere. No actual selection behavior or persisted employee data is observed.

criteria.title: Original requirement 3
criteria.source: The static Password control markup in both login.html and sign-up.html must use input type password

reference.rationale: Both supplied pages have the Password label associated with input id=password but the actual input type is text. This directly contradicts the explicit static attribute requirement. It is not a claim that an exploitable vulnerability or real authentication outcome was tested.

criteria.title: Original requirement 4
criteria.source: The static Email control markup in sign-up.html must use input type email rather than text

reference.rationale: The Email label for=e-mail points to input id=e-mail with type=text, not type=email. The specific source attribute requirement is unmet; runtime validation or successful email delivery is not inferred.

criteria.title: Original requirement 5
criteria.source: Actual sign in must reject invalid credentials and protect the dashboard from unauthenticated access

reference.rationale: The template has sign-in links and credential-looking controls, but no authenticated server requests or access checks were performed. External scripts and backend are not in the source subset. An HTML href cannot prove real authentication succeeds or prove the deployed site has no additional access controls.

criteria.title: Original requirement 6
criteria.source: The employer form must actually store the selected employment value and return the same saved record after a reload

reference.rationale: The static forms source includes employment choices and controls, but no storage/readback, reload execution or backend evidence exists. Default checked/value attributes do not establish an actual persisted record.
